title: Pay the statutory domestic building insurance premium
what: Pay the domestic building insurance premium to the Authority (the state's statutory insurance scheme) before starting work under an insurable domestic building contract.

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 137O(1) (authorised version 152, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: (1) A builder who enters into an insurable domestic building contract (other than a prescribed insurable domestic building contract) must pay the applicable insurance premium to the Authority before the first of the following to happen— (a) 10 business days elapse after the day on which the contract is entered into; (b) the domestic building work starts.

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 137AAB(1) (authorised version 152, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: (1) Insurance obtained on and after the commencement day for the purposes of an order under section 135 relating to domestic building work must be obtained solely from the Authority.

administration.note: Runs the statutory insurance scheme and collects the premium.
